help.text:
DesktopORZ — desktop icon layout manager

Usage:
  save <profile>                    Saves the current layout to the profile
  save-res <profile> [<W>x<H>]      Saves the layout for a specific resolution
  profile-update <profile>          Updates the profile's main layout
  restore <profile>                 Restores the profile's layout
  list                              Lists saved profiles
  startup [on <profile>|off|status]  Manages automatic startup
  wait-drive [on <profile> [--timeout <s>]|off|status]  Waits for Google Drive at startup
  hide-icons [on <s> [--kb] [--mou]|off|status]  Hides icons after inactivity (KB=keyboard, MOU=mouse)
  lang [<code>]                     Shows or changes the language (e.g., lang en)
  help                              Shows this help
